title: wildmat: redundant to_ascii_lowercase allocations per call
description: matches_wildmat calls to_ascii_lowercase() on both the name and pattern on every invocation, allocating two new Strings. In the hot paths (GroupFilter::accepts called per group per article; list_active/list_newsgroups called per group per LIST command) these allocations accumulate. Patterns are stable after construction -- they are never modified after GroupFilter::new(). Fix: lowercase bare_pattern at parse time in WildmatPattern::parse (one allocation at construction, zero at match time). For the name argument, valid NNTP group names are required to be lowercase by RFC 3977 so the to_ascii_lowercase call on the name side is also avoidable if the caller guarantees lowercase input -- which GroupFilter::accepts can assert via debug_assert and document. This eliminates two String allocations per call with no algorithmic change.
